faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CUSAT Technician Grade II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the CUSAT Technician Grade II recruitment is 05-09-2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Technician Grade II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an ITI certificate in Diesel Mechanic with a minimum of one year of experience in Marine Diesel Engine Maintenance or have served as PO (ME) in the Indian Navy.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Technician Grade II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Technician Grade II post is 62 years. There are no minimum age requirements specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Technician Grade II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Technician Grade II position will receive a salary of Rs. 25,980 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Technician Grade II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Technician Grade II post at Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Rs. 950. This fee is payable online during the application process.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for SC/ST candidates is Rs. 195. This fee is payable online as part of the application submission.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the CUSAT Technician Grade II recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official CUSAT website.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Technician Grade II post is on a contract basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed period as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for CUSAT Technician Grade II recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.
